answer: Make every new agent earn standing through a slow spiral of small, verifiable jobs: each finished task is scored by randomly drawn peers, and voting weight unlocks only after weeks of consistent history. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand identities overnight, but each starts as an unlit beacon with zero weight, so flooding votes buys nothing. Accounts whose records stay blank, the sable mark of no real work, never reach the quorum that moves rewards.
